import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (low high : Int) (left right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def low (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ l _ _ _ => l

def high (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ h _ _ => h

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ l _ => l

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Int → Option Int :=
  fun k =>
    if k < t.low ∨ k ≥ t.high then none
    else
      match t.left, t.right with
      | some l, some r =>
          if k < l.high then view l k else view r k
      | _, _ => some t.val
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_segment_tree (t : Node) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ t.low ∧ t.low < t.high ∧ 0 ≤ t.val ∧
  match t.left, t.right with
  | some l, some r =>
      let mid := (t.low + t.high) / 2
      l.low = t.low ∧ l.high = mid ∧
      r.low = mid ∧ r.high = t.high ∧
      is_segment_tree l ∧ is_segment_tree r ∧
      t.val = max l.val r.val
  | none, none =>
      t.high = t.low + 1
  | _, _ => False
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def build_precond (l r : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  0 ≤ l ∧ l < r
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def buildAux (l r : Int) : Node :=
  if h : r ≤ l + 1 then
    Node.mk 0 l r none none
  else
    Node.mk 0 l r (some (buildAux l ((l + r) / 2))) (some (buildAux ((l + r) / 2) r))
termination_by (r - l).toNat
decreasing_by
  all_goals omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def build (l r : Int)
    (h_precond : build_precond l r) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  buildAux l r
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Abstract View Helper used in Postcond
def tree_view_at (t : Node) (k : Int) : Int :=
  match view t k with
  | some v => v
  | none => 0 -- Should not happen for in-range queries if consistent

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def build_postcond (l r : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : build_precond l r) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_segment_tree result ∧
  result.low = l ∧
  result.high = r ∧
  (∀ k, l ≤ k ∧ k < r → tree_view_at result k = 0)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma buildAux_low (l r : Int) : (buildAux l r).low = l := by
  rw [buildAux.eq_def]
  split <;> rfl

lemma buildAux_high (l r : Int) : (buildAux l r).high = r := by
  rw [buildAux.eq_def]
  split <;> rfl

lemma buildAux_val (l r : Int) : (buildAux l r).val = 0 := by
  rw [buildAux.eq_def]
  split <;> rfl

lemma view_leaf_eq (v lo hi k : Int) (h1 : lo ≤ k) (h2 : k < hi) :
    view (Node.mk v lo hi none none) k = some v := by
  rw [view.eq_def]
  simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.left, Node.right, Node.val,
    not_lt.mpr h1, not_le.mpr h2]

lemma view_node_left (v lo hi k : Int) (L R : Node) (h1 : lo ≤ k) (h2 : k < hi)
    (h3 : k < L.high) :
    view (Node.mk v lo hi (some L) (some R)) k = view L k := by
  obtain ⟨lv, llo, lhi, ll, lr⟩ := L
  simp only [Node.high] at h3
  rw [view.eq_def]
  simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.left, Node.right,
    not_lt.mpr h1, not_le.mpr h2, h3]

lemma view_node_right (v lo hi k : Int) (L R : Node) (h1 : lo ≤ k) (h2 : k < hi)
    (h3 : L.high ≤ k) :
    view (Node.mk v lo hi (some L) (some R)) k = view R k := by
  obtain ⟨lv, llo, lhi, ll, lr⟩ := L
  simp only [Node.high] at h3
  rw [view.eq_def]
  simp [Node.low, Node.high, Node.left, Node.right,
    not_lt.mpr h1, not_le.mpr h2, not_lt.mpr h3]

lemma ist_leaf (v lo hi : Int) (h0 : 0 ≤ lo) (h1 : lo < hi) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hh : hi = lo + 1) : is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi none none) := by
  rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def]
  exact ⟨h0, h1, hv, hh⟩

lemma ist_node (v lo hi : Int) (L R : Node) (h0 : 0 ≤ lo) (h1 : lo < hi) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hL1 : L.low = lo) (hL2 : L.high = (lo + hi) / 2)
    (hR1 : R.low = (lo + hi) / 2) (hR2 : R.high = hi)
    (hL : is_segment_tree L) (hR : is_segment_tree R)
    (hval : v = max L.val R.val) :
    is_segment_tree (Node.mk v lo hi (some L) (some R)) := by
  rw [is_segment_tree.eq_def]
  exact ⟨h0, h1, hv, hL1, hL2, hR1, hR2, hL, hR, hval⟩

lemma buildAux_spec (n : ℕ) : ∀ (l r : Int), r - l ≤ (n : Int) → 0 ≤ l → l < r →
    is_segment_tree (buildAux l r) ∧
      ∀ k, l ≤ k → k < r → view (buildAux l r) k = some 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l r hn hl hlr
    exfalso
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l r hn hl hlr
    by_cases h : r ≤ l + 1
    · have hb : buildAux l r = Node.mk 0 l r none none := by
        rw [buildAux.eq_def]; simp [h]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hb]
        exact ist_leaf 0 l r hl hlr le_rfl (by omega)
      · intro k hk1 hk2
        rw [hb]
        exact view_leaf_eq 0 l r k hk1 hk2
    · have hm1 : l < (l + r) / 2 := by omega
      have hm2 : (l + r) / 2 < r := by omega
      have hb : buildAux l r = Node.mk 0 l r (some (buildAux l ((l + r) / 2)))
          (some (buildAux ((l + r) / 2) r)) := by
        rw [buildAux.eq_def]; simp [h]
      have hL := ih l ((l + r) / 2) (by omega) hl hm1
      have hR := ih ((l + r) / 2) r (by omega) (by omega) hm2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hb]
        refine ist_node 0 l r (buildAux l ((l + r) / 2)) (buildAux ((l + r) / 2) r)
          hl hlr le_rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hL.1 hR.1 ?_
        · exact buildAux_low _ _
        · exact buildAux_high _ _
        · exact buildAux_low _ _
        · exact buildAux_high _ _
        · rw [buildAux_val, buildAux_val]; simp
      · intro k hk1 hk2
        rw [hb]
        by_cases hkm : k < (l + r) / 2
        · have hstep := view_node_left 0 l r k (buildAux l ((l + r) / 2))
            (buildAux ((l + r) / 2) r) hk1 hk2 (by rw [buildAux_high]; exact hkm)
          rw [hstep]
          exact hL.2 k hk1 hkm
        · have hstep := view_node_right 0 l r k (buildAux l ((l + r) / 2))
            (buildAux ((l + r) / 2) r) hk1 hk2 (by rw [buildAux_high]; omega)
          rw [hstep]
          exact hR.2 k (by omega) hk2
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem build_postcond_satisfied (l r : Int)
    (h_precond : build_precond l r) :
    build_postcond l r (build l r h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hl : (0 : Int) ≤ l := h_precond.1
  have hlr : l < r := h_precond.2
  have hmeas : r - l ≤ (((r - l).toNat : ℕ) : Int) := Int.self_le_toNat _
  have h := buildAux_spec (r - l).toNat l r hmeas hl hlr
  have hbe : build l r h_precond = buildAux l r := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hbe]; exact h.1
  · rw [hbe]; exact buildAux_low l r
  · rw [hbe]; exact buildAux_high l r
  · intro k hk
    have h2 : view (buildAux l r) k = some 0 := h.2 k hk.1 hk.2
    show tree_view_at (buildAux l r) k = 0
    simp [tree_view_at, h2]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
